title: Japanese Chicken Casserole
description: A unique fusion of Japanese flavors in a classic American casserole, featuring tender chicken and a warm, spicy kick.
instructions: Cook the Japanese rice according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, sauté the chicken breasts in a little oil until browned.
Add soy sauce, sake, and Gochujang to the pan and stir to coat the chicken.
Transfer the chicken mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
In a separate bowl, mix together cooked Japanese rice, green onions, and grated daikon.
Spread the rice mixture evenly over the chicken.
Sprinkle panko breadcrumbs over the cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
